title: gilia floccosa var. filifolia
intro: Gilia floccosa var. filifolia, commonly known as gilia, is a flowering plant species in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). The plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to support immune function and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and infections. The bioactive constituents of gilia floccosa var. filifolia include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
